page.notes: Doubtful readings: "so'um" (printed with an apostrophe-like mark, possibly "solum"); "agut" (likely a printing error for "agunt"); "praecipuum" in the margin note; "co-sessionum" (the word after the hyphen is read as "sessionum"). The run-together "urbeshoc" is as printed. Printed hyphens kept at line ends. The page number is printed with an i-like first digit, read as 106.
